about: Everything on the mat that is somebody else's work, apart from the Qur'an texts. Those carry their own SOURCE.json beside the text, so that a translation added to one mat by hand brings its credit with it -- see salaah/sources.py.

items.what: Hadith of Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim
items.note: Public domain (Unlicense). Arabic and English matched to each other by hadith number.

items.what: Arabic faces: Scheherazade New, Noto Naskh Arabic, Amiri
items.publisher: SIL International and the Amiri project

items.what: Recitation of the Qur'an, verse by verse
items.note: Fetched when a verse is played; nothing is stored on the mat beyond the verse being read.

items.what: UK postcode districts, for finding a town
items.note: The attribution its licence requires is shown on the Location screen.

items.what: Towns and cities of the world, for finding a place outside the UK
items.via: the cities15000 table, places of 15,000 people or more, carried as a snapshot rather than fetched
items.note: The table is a snapshot taken at build time, so the mat needs no network to find a town. Rebuilt by tools/build_cities.py.
